The '''Emperor's Shield''' was a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]]s. They were trained by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] and given missions in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] during the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], and were later assigned to protect [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] during his inspection of the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]]. Upon the Emperor's arrival, the Emperor's Shield squadron participated in the flight parade alongside [[Scythe Squadron/Legends|Scythe Squadron]] and [[The Emperor's Sword|Emperor's Sword]].
